head: Airalo eSIM: one install for every trip, no new eSIM each time
dek: Airalo is rolling out a single eSIM that stays on your phone for all your trips over the coming months. You'll buy the package you need for each trip instead of installing a new eSIM every time.
details: It runs on Airalo's own core network. Plans for single countries, regions and the whole world stay, and the global plan gets an option with calls and texts.
where: Airalo app, rolling out over the coming months
means: If you travel to several countries a year, your phone won't fill up with a stack of travel eSIMs.
todo: Nothing to do yet; when the update reaches you, the Airalo app will offer the single eSIM.
thumb_words: ONE AIRALO ESIM FOR ALL TRIPS
